 "inherited_national_exposure": [
  "National passport/visa sex-marker regime (Jan 2025 executive order; X-marker discontinued for new issues Feb 2025; Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025; passports confiscated/blocked, travellers stranded)",
  "Border/entry screening exposure: Feb 2025 visa ban and internal flagging of trans athletes/applicants listing a gender other than assigned sex, treated as fraud grounds for permanent ban",
  "National facilities policy: funding barred for single-sex facilities congruent with gender identity; state/province bathroom bans in schools/government buildings, with criminal exposure in some units and an April 2025 restroom arrest",
  "Custody/detention exposure: corrections-bureau policies described as conversion-therapy-style (hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution) from 2026; cessation of trans-prisoner reporting from 2025; immigration-custody forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and sexual abuse reports",
  "Official hostility/threat-framing: Dec 2025 cash-bounty instruction against trans activists; May 2026 counterterrorism strategy framing 'radically pro-transgender' ideology as a security threat",
  "National travel advisories: at least eight allied governments adjusted guidance for trans/nonbinary citizens by Mar 2025; further advisories by Apr 2025; four units flagged 'Do Not Travel' by an advocacy risk map (Jul 2026)",
  "Partial protection machinery: national gender-identity hate-crime coverage and 2020 employment ruling (under challenge), with only 23 units covering gender identity in bias-crime statutes; marriage recognition and public-opinion data are climate signals only"
 ],
 "uncertainty": "The division's local bundle is empty: no local statute, enforcement record, incident, facility rule, official statement or travel guidance is supplied. There is therefore no documented local departure from the fixed national level in either direction. A zero delta here is a diagnostic of missing evidence, not proof that the division matches the national average; genuine unit-level variation (the national dossier itself shows uneven bathroom bans, marker-change rules and risk-map flags across units) may exist but cannot be assessed from this run.",
 "notes": "No local facts to weigh, so nothing is counted toward the delta. All national-level exposures (document/border friction, facilities restrictions, custody practice, official threat-framing, advisory climate and partial recourse) remain inherited and already priced into the frozen 0.330; none is re-counted as a local difference. Should a local bundle later document unit-specific measures — e.g. an enacted bathroom or marker-invalidation law, documented enforcement against trans visitors, or a local protection actually operating — those would move the delta down or up respectively; the empty bundle supports neither."}
